articles.title: Anchorage Digital to unveil new asset-management subsidiary
articles.snippet: The crypto custody technology firm said it will unveil a separate subsidiary called 61st Parallel Asset Management.

articles.title: Swiss central bank, UBS and SIX study ledger for tokenized settlement
articles.snippet: The study will assess whether a shared ledger can bring central bank money, commercial bank money and securities onto the same platform.

articles.title: Ethereum Foundation doubles protocol security team ahead of overhaul
articles.snippet: The foundation said its next upgrade will be harder than the Merge, and the required pace of development will make it easier to ship bugs.

articles.title: OpenAI and Anthropic Insiders Fear Their Next AI Models Are Too Dangerous to Release
articles.snippet: Employees at both AI labs reportedly question whether their strongest models should ever reach the public, as researchers struggle to keep increasingly capable systems under control during training and testing.

articles.title: Ethereum Foundation Says AI Is a More Urgent Threat Than Quantum Computing
articles.snippet: The Ethereum Foundation has doubled its protocol security team and is prioritizing a cryptographic overhaul as advances in AI threaten the mathematical assumptions that keep billions in crypto safe.
